<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Acme;

final class Greeter
{
    use Shouting;

    public function greet(string $name): string
    {
        return 'Hello ' . $name . $this->missing();
    }

    public function count(): int
    {
        return strlen(42);
    }

    public function ignored(): int
    {
        return $this->alsoMissing();
    }

    public function items(): array
    {
        return [];
    }
}
